en: Black‑and‑white divided postcard with two rural views. The upper image shows a farming landscape with a field of stacked sheaves in the foreground, a small village behind, and a church with a tower rising above the trees. The lower image depicts a village street bordered by houses and trees, with a church tower and spire visible in the background; a cart and a signpost are seen near the road. Between the two images is a decorative script title reading "Lampertswalde b. Großenhain".
